title: Built a few stock flipper apps last week on different AI platforms
author: Aggressive-Square257
selftext:
The goal was to flip stock charts and listen to information about the company while I walk on the treadmill. 

I wanted everything on a timer and a teleprompter style text box for the company information I also wanted it read out loud to me as I walked on the treadmill and looked at the chart. The goal was to not pay for anything and use free data.

Here's what I found out, my first try was grok and it did a good job because grok was able to access  data that could be constantly updated. Pretty good job 

Next I tried Claude and thought it was doing great until I realized that it was only making a demos and that it would be a a lot of effort to have it constantly update things. Great for the demo but what good is a demo if it's not constantly updating with current financial data or at least slightly delayed. 

Then I tried Gemini AI studio and loved it, it did everything right and better than I wanted, plus the free version took care of everything without going over my daily limit. Everything seems to be tied to Google finance so I had a lot of options with keeping everything relevant and updated. Google Gemini won the prize for my new favorite application, stock chart clipper with relevant news coverage read to me as I walk on the treadmill. 

Just wanted to share, I've only been building for about a week and a half and I'm learning what the different AI providers are good at.
